description: Austrian diplomatic/consular plate prefixes: the Land letter of KDV § 26 Abs. 3 (B, K, N, O, S, ST, T, V, W) — or, for vehicles based in Graz, the Anlage 5d authority code G (§ 26 Abs. 5) — followed by D (diplomatic corps, international organisations) or K (consular corps). Cross product, 20 values. Several collide with Anlage 5d district codes (ND, GD, NK, SD, VK), a genuine textual ambiguity of the Austrian system.
